test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Feb, 2026 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: ‘Jhanjhar’ is a popular dance of which of the following Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jharkhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Jhanjhar dance** is a vibrant and rhythmic folk dance primarily performed in the state of **Jharkhand**, specifically within the tribal regions.
 
• It is traditionally associated with the **Munda** and **Santhal** tribes, who use this dance form to celebrate social gatherings and seasonal changes.
 
• The dance derives its name from the **Jhanjh**, which is a traditional musical instrument consisting of a pair of **brass cymbals** that produce a rhythmic metallic sound.
 
• The performance is characterized by the high-energy movements of the dancers who move in **circular or semi-circular formations**, mirroring the unity and collective spirit of the tribal community.
 
• It is often performed during significant cultural festivals such as **Sarhul** and **Karma**, which are dedicated to nature and the deities of the forest.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Folk Dances of Jharkhand:**

 
 
• **Chhau Dance:** Specifically the **Seraikella Chhau**, it is a famous masked dance that depicts stories from the **Mahabharata** and **Ramayana**. It was added to the **UNESCO** Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity in **2010**.
 
• **Paika Dance:** A martial folk dance performed by the **Munda** community, where dancers carry **swords and shields** to display military bravery.
 
• **Karma Dance:** Performed during the **Karma festival** in the month of **Bhado** (August-September), it involves the worshipping of the **Karam tree** which symbolizes fertility and prosperity.
 
• **Santhali Dance:** Usually performed by the **Santhal** tribe during the **Sohrai** and **Baha** festivals, characterized by intricate footwork and the use of the **Madar** (drum).
 
 
 
• **Geographical and Cultural Context:**
 
 
• **Jharkhand** was officially formed on **15 November 2000**, after being carved out from the southern part of **Bihar**.
 
• The state is known as the **"Land of Forests"** and is situated on the **Chota Nagpur Plateau**, which influences its unique tribal art forms and lifestyle.
 
• The primary musical instruments used in Jharkhand folk music include the **Nagada**, **Dhol**, **Bansi** (flute), and **Turi**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Tribal Festivals:** The **Sarhul** festival is the most popular tribal festival in **Jharkhand**, celebrated when the **Sal trees** get new flowers, marking the beginning of the New Year for the tribes.
 
• **Socio-Economic Significance:** These folk dances like **Jhanjhar** are not merely entertainment but are essential for maintaining the oral traditions and cultural history of the **32 recognized tribes** of the state.
 
• **Global Recognition:** Tribal art from Jharkhand, including **Sohrai and Khovar painting**, received the **Geographical Indication (GI) tag** in **2020**, further highlighting the state's rich heritage alongside its performing arts.
